messages:
maria.chen: Quick check — are we locking the launch social posts for Wednesday 9am PT across X + LinkedIn? Need final assets, copy variants, and seedlist.

aj: Yes, wed 9am PT works. I pushed the draft calendar to the shared sheet. Two copy variants: short-for-x and long-for-linkedin. Who can confirm creative? :eyes:

tasha: I can own creative. We should have a static carousel + 15s clip for paid amplifying. Can we get final brand-safe frames by EOD Tuesday?

maria.chen: Perfect. Also need UTMs and the inbound lead routing rule — want leads from organic/social labeled `launch_q2` and routed to SDR rotation A. Can someone paste the routing rule syntax?

sam_k: Routing rule we'll use in HubSpot: `if source contains launch_q2 then owner = sdr_rotation_A, tag = social_launch`. I'll drop the seedlist CSV into the drive now (`/marketing/launch/seedlists/launch_q2-seed.csv`).

ops-bot: scheduled_post_bot: Draft scheduled: X post (87321) queued for 2024-05-15T16:00:00Z. LinkedIn draft (87322) queued for 2024-05-15T16:15:00Z.

natalie_marketing: Benchmark narrative reminder — in copy highlight: predictable latency, cost-per-request, and easy migration between hosted/dedicated. We want a one-liner for the hero + 2 bullets. Example: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower unit cost."

aj: For A/B: short X: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency." LinkedIn long: "Build LLM experiences backed by predictable latency, lower per-token cost, and enterprise-ready controls. Register for our webinar to see benchmarks."

tasha: Creative ask: include 2 static frames: product screenshot + benchmark stat (e.g., "2.5x throughput"). Also export 1080x1080 + 1200x627.

maria.chen: Can someone confirm tracking params for the webinar CTA? We'll want UTM string appended. Example: `?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_org&utm_campaign=launch_q2`. Thoughts?

sam_k: That UTM looks good. For LinkedIn use `utm_medium=linkedin`. For X use `utm_medium=x`. Also add `utm_content=variant_a` for A/B test.

sdr-queue: sdr-queue: Confirmed — incoming leads tagged `launch_q2` will create a task in the SDR queue with priority=high. Rotation A on weekdays, rotation B on weekends.

ops-bot: automation_bot: Seedlist upload detected: `/marketing/launch/seedlists/launch_q2-seed.csv` (3,520 entries). Routing rule applied.

maria.chen: Awesome. Last thing — follow-ups: we want a short engagement plan post-live: 1) reply to top 20 comments day-of, 2) DM new followers with webinar link for 48hrs, 3) push high-engage users to AE nurture list. Can ops/SDR confirm capacity?

sdr-queue: SDRs can pick top leads for immediate outreach — we'll prioritize by engagement score > 80.

tasha: I'll upload final assets to `/marketing/launch/assets/` by 5pm PT. Will ping here when done. :white_check_mark:

maria.chen: Thanks everyone — will finalize calendar and share final post copy in this thread once assets are in.

---
Notes (internal):
- Posting schedule: X 16:00Z, LinkedIn 16:15Z
- UTMs: `utm_campaign=launch_q2`, `utm_source=social`, `utm_medium=[x|linkedin]`, `utm_content=[variant]`
- Routing: tag `launch_q2` -> SDR rotation A (weekday)
- Assets: carousel (static), 15s clip, sized 1080x1080 + 1200x627
- Benchmark callouts: latency + cost per request + migration story
